name: robinhood-token-sentinel
description: Real-time Robinhood Chain token launch monitor and contract risk scanner

scripts.dev: concurrently -n scanner,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @sentinel/scanner" "npm run dev -w @sentinel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/shared && npm run build -w @sentinel/scanner && npm run build -w @sentinel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sentinel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/scanner && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/web
